blocks.title: EEMS Platform — reference flow in production
blocks.note: The pipeline is measured end to end; each stage reports its own freshness and cost, which is what makes the unit economics arguable.

blocks.x: Under the hood the pattern is a composition, not a monolith: 4 tower services, the EEMS Platform platform for rails, and your estate at core systems for truth. Every boundary is a contract; every contract has an SLO and an owner.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
Baseline measured and signed, the metric and owner named, the risk envelope agreed in writing.
Prove (6-10 weeks)
The pilot runs on real data with a control group — the gate review happens whether the news is good or not.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
Hardening, enablement and scale-out in that order — no rollout faster than the evidence.
Compound (ongoing)
The next decisions enter the same loop — the backlog ranked by measured value per week of effort.

blocks.x: The daily rhythm becomes legible — what ran, what it cost, what it changed — so the morning conversation shifts from status guessing to decision review.
Integration for EEMS Platform — Industry Use Cases follows one rule: the system of record stays authoritative. Decisions and analytics read from it; nothing writes back without a reviewable path.
